treatment_description: Organic crop management (rice + wheat combined, organic inputs only)
control_description: Inorganic crop management (rice + wheat combined, synthetic inputs)
notes: System productivity (REY) difference between organic and inorganic is NOT significant (difference 143.7 kg/ha < LSD 496.0). REY computed as rice grain yield + (wheat yield × wheat price / rice price). The small gap (-1.88%) suggests organic system nearly matches conventional over 15 years when both crops are combined. The organic rice gain partially offsets the organic wheat loss.
title: Effect of organic farming on the restoration of soil quality, ecosystem services, and productivity in rice–wheat agro-ecosystems
authors: Panwar AS, Ansari MA, Ravisankar N, Babu S, Prusty AK, Ghasal PC, Choudhary J, Shamim M, Singh R, Raghavendra KJ, Dutta D, Meena AL, Chauhan GV, Ansari MH, Singh R, Aulakh CS, Singh DK, Sharma PB
